## Proof

A CI check (verify-claims) requires this block. For each line, either check it
and give a REAL, reviewer-accessible artifact (CI/fork Actions URL, PR
attachment, or tracked repository-relative path), or leave it unchecked with
"n/a — <reason>". Absolute/local paths, localhost URLs, and ignored .context
files do not count. A docs-only PR can mark everything n/a.

Opening from a FORK? The check runs in strict mode and will NOT accept "n/a" on
the runtime: line — link the green CI run on your fork (Actions tab → your
branch), or attach a screenshot for a UI change. See CONTRIBUTING.md → "Pull
requests". Everything else can still be n/a.

For WebSocket or compatibility work, runtime/schema proof should identify the
integration commit, exact frontend tag+commit where relevant, HA Core/frontend
versions for live proof, browser, skew result, and performance-report link.
-->
